Stride multi-agent edition

Version 0.10.0 · November 5, 2026 · Multi-agent edition. GitHub Pages serves the interface; a separate backend runs the agent team.

One chat, a specialist team

A model-driven coordinator delegates bounded tasks to independent resume, interview and career planning loops, then combines successful findings. Each specialist has separate instructions and restricted tools. Simple greetings can be handled by the coordinator alone.

RAG and actual actions

Specialists retrieve local guidance before generating findings. Source IDs are validated at both layers. Expand Sources and agent activity below replies to inspect actual actions, rather than private model reasoning.

Career workspace

Chat, Career Plan, Recommended Jobs and Applications retain plans, postings and application progress in this browser. Saved items can be discussed with the coach; application statuses are entered manually, and the app does not submit applications.

Employer research and favorites

Research an employer with cited web sources covering its business, products, dated news and interview preparation. Save companies and personal notes in Favorite Companies. Briefings are dated and require verification; favorites can be saved without an API key.

Live job postings

Ask to find actual jobs with a role, location and work arrangement. The career planning specialist searches the web, checks individual employer/ATS posting pages and returns application links. Search uses your API quota. Coverage is limited; confirm availability on the employer page. Without an API key, practice mode cannot search online.

Limits and privacy

At most 16 model calls and three specialist consultations per request, with a 120-second HTTP timeout. Multiple agents may increase latency and token usage. Source validation does not prove factual accuracy, relevance or perfect prompt-injection resistance. Messages, documents, history, context and guidance are sent to OpenAI. Use redacted data. Online visitors enter their own key for each tab; requests pass through the hosted backend to OpenAI. Keys are not saved in chats, exports or browser storage. Without a key, practice templates remain available. Chats remain in browser storage until deleted.

Validation and remaining work

145 automated tests pass. Five small fictional live checks cover interview drafting, a combined resume/plan request, a topic change, a document instruction attack and a greeting. They are development checks, not a held-out benchmark or proof of student outcomes. Student testing, broader answer-quality comparison and the final presentation remain. Verify the live backend status and an actual reply after deployment.
